_about: Deep Cut's public launch day (Jorge, Nov 12, 2026: game numbers count from it; #1 is the first public day, earlier days are previews). Placeholder until Jorge sets the date. scripts/build.mjs copies it to public/config.json, which the page reads. The day locks keep their own n (days since data/schedule.json start); the page does not show it. seconds: the time per question in the Daily and practice (Jorge, Nov 12: 20, may become 25 or 30); scripts/build.mjs copies it to public/config.json, which the page and the Deep Cut server read, so changing it needs no rebuild of the prompts.
